name: Dustbowl
summary: In the Badlands, travelers cross the Dustbowl between Kargath and the Valley of Fangs. Its dry gullies and open ground are roamed by coyotes, buzzards, and rock elementals.

sections.title: A Scorched Crossing
sections.body:
Camp Wurg marks the Dustbowl in the northwestern Badlands. Dry gulches cut through cracked clay, and harsh winds sweep grit across the open flatland. Cacti and scattered, gnarled trees cling to the barren soil.

Coyotes prowl, buzzards circle overhead, and living rock elementals wander the rugged earth. Without a guide, crossing this wilderness is perilous. Camp Wurg offers a landmark amid the scrub, between Kargath and the Valley of Fangs.

faq.answer: The Dustbowl lies in the northwestern Badlands, between Kargath to the west and the Valley of Fangs near the center.
Coyotes prowl the Dustbowl, while buzzards circle overhead. Rock elementals wander its stony ground.

faq.q: What landmarks are found in the Dustbowl?
faq.answer: Camp Wurg is a landmark in the Dustbowl, between Kargath and the central Badlands.

faq.q: Can any plant life survive out here?
faq.answer: Hardy cacti and scattered, gnarled trees grow in the Dustbowl despite its dry climate.

angles.text: Just beyond Kargath, the Dustbowl is the first open wilderness Horde scouts cross when heading east into the Badlands.
